geometry_script.method: Python: nominal room bounds, pairwise exact AABB checks; 0.25-degree swept thin door rectangles tested by separating-axis theorem; .5-inch-grid widest disk path for routes. Door states separate. No generic unverified footprint substituted for a purchasable product.
geometry_script.exclusions: Rug under furniture, mattress on bed, wall art, curtains behind furniture and lamp atop nightstand are intentional vertical layers. Nook tabletop above seat is allowed; base is checked separately.

rental_checks.notes: Closet interior shelves/drawers must be inventoried for month-long stays; no dresser is mandatory under council rules. Fixed-height contoured wood work chair is supportive but not an adjustable task chair; ergonomic upgrade remains an option, not an unverified fabric recommendation. Quality uses22-inch-high Miles Mini tables (16x15), not the taller value23.25-inch TONSTAD; price449 each last checked16November.
assembly_gates: Install required anti-tip restraints before letting (primary chest).
Measure quality assembled mattress top: target22–25 inches with22-inch nightstands. Slat spacing/load and rental warranty need confirmation.
GRUSNARV is fitted waterproof protection, not a zippered encasement; full bedbug encasement remains an optional unsourced procurement upgrade.
Test sealed blackout peel-away and normal exterior-opening operation; do not obstruct bedroom escape.
rental_checks.glass_policy_interpretation: No glass furniture, lamp shades, vessels or picture glazing. Required functional safety-backed wall mirrors and TV display are not mirrored furniture; neither is freestanding/leaning. Obtain owner clarification if literal no-glass includes required functional mirror.
rental_checks.conditional_measurement: Clear room depth must be at least142.35 inches to retain30-inch desk-chair zone with this23.6-inch desk and fixed bed position; nominal143.5 +/-3 makes this conditional. Value18.5-inch desk is the robust fallback.

layouts.rationale: East is the only uninterrupted headboard wall: north is the slider, west the bathroom/pocket and south the closet. Omit a dresser rather than pinch the desk chair; the 105-inch reach-in closet supplies monthly hanging/shelf storage.
layouts.budget_basis: USD item-only. New research/supplied catalog prices17Nov2026 except quality Miles Mini nightstands449 each, last checked16Nov. Taxes, freight, assembly, installation and mounting fasteners excluded. Linen rotations, purchased frame packs and spare bulbs included; no membership discount.

geometry.hero_view: Hall doorway southeast corner, camera 50 inches, looking northwest: full queen, paired lights, the open slider, and real desk in separate frame.
removes: all existing movable furniture; no gym, cat furniture, desk or owner seating retained

windows.sash_access: Primary sash from clear side or over15–15.75-inch bedside top (22 quality/23.25 value), below stool underside26.7. Guest slider has full24.75/26-inch north strip; corrected west-wall luggage does not choke approach.

other.storage: 105-inch-wide reach-in closet, not a claim of measured drawer volume; retain shelves/hangers for two guests.
other.worst_case_note: Room metrology not tape-verified. Primary gap varies about +/-1.5 inches with room width; guest desk zone varies about +/-3 inches with depth. Tape before order; a nominal fit is not an as-built guarantee.
other.closet_open_pinch_note: 20.8-inch quality /20.35-inch value conservative disk path with closet open; closed is23.01 /23.5. Closet opening remains90 degrees; entry open too.

geometry_script.method: Python: nominal room bounds, pairwise exact AABB checks; 0.25-degree swept thin door rectangles tested by separating-axis theorem; .5-inch-grid widest disk path for routes. Door states separate. No generic unverified footprint substituted for a purchasable product.
geometry_script.exclusions: Rug under furniture, mattress on bed, wall art, curtains behind furniture and lamp atop nightstand are intentional vertical layers. Nook tabletop above seat is allowed; base is checked separately.

rental_checks.notes: Closet interior shelves/drawers must be inventoried for month-long stays; no dresser is mandatory under council rules. Fixed-height contoured wood work chair is supportive but not an adjustable task chair; ergonomic upgrade remains an option, not an unverified fabric recommendation. Quality uses22-inch-high Miles Mini tables (16x15), not the taller value23.25-inch TONSTAD; price449 each last checked16November.
assembly_gates: Install required anti-tip restraints before letting (primary chest).
Measure quality assembled mattress top: target22–25 inches with22-inch nightstands. Slat spacing/load and rental warranty need confirmation.
GRUSNARV is fitted waterproof protection, not a zippered encasement; full bedbug encasement remains an optional unsourced procurement upgrade.
Test sealed blackout peel-away and normal exterior-opening operation; do not obstruct bedroom escape.
rental_checks.glass_policy_interpretation: No glass furniture, lamp shades, vessels or picture glazing. Required functional safety-backed wall mirrors and TV display are not mirrored furniture; neither is freestanding/leaning. Obtain owner clarification if literal no-glass includes required functional mirror.
rental_checks.conditional_measurement: Clear room depth must be at least142.35 inches to retain30-inch desk-chair zone with this23.6-inch desk and fixed bed position; nominal143.5 +/-3 makes this conditional. Value18.5-inch desk is the robust fallback.

geometry.rationale: East is the only uninterrupted headboard wall: north is the slider, west the bathroom/pocket and south the closet. Omit a dresser rather than pinch the desk chair; the 105-inch reach-in closet supplies monthly hanging/shelf storage.
geometry.budget_basis: USD item-only. New research/supplied catalog prices17Nov2026 except quality Miles Mini nightstands449 each, last checked16Nov. Taxes, freight, assembly, installation and mounting fasteners excluded. Linen rotations, purchased frame packs and spare bulbs included; no membership discount.
relocation: cat posts moved out for rental

layouts.hero_view: From southeast hall doorway, camera 50 inches high, across the queen toward the clear slider; second photograph from northwest shows real desk and closet.
layouts.rationale: Warm oak/acorn, Sedona percale and one desert-art pair carry the scheme; walnut quality bed deliberately bridges the cognac living room instead of unverified upholstered Miles fabric. Bare oak floors are intentional: no unverified non-washable rug. Closet complements drawers; no current furniture retained.
removes: All existing movable furniture; no reuse assumed.

hand_checks.method: Executable Python rectangle/SAT audit against exact room JSON; quarter-degree one-sided door-leaf sweeps; explicit analytic corridor/ellipse calculations. Survey, not tape-verified.

other.tucked_state_condition: Chair arms/seat/base must fit open desk knee bay; bounding boxes intentionally nest at different heights. Trial assembly required.
other.hall_to_bath_route: From hall y121 move west to x80, north into y97.5 or99.2 cross-aisle, west to x23, then north to pocket door.
other.both_entry_and_closet_at_90: clear of furniture and each other; opposing leaf edges5.625in apart
other.chair_in_use: Working/pulled-out chair can narrow bathroom route below20in; only tucked state is hard-checked, as brief requires.

hard_rules: Task chair lacks a captured Wyzenbeek >=30000 and W/WS cleaning code for the exact selected upholstery; NOT rental-certified.
Waterproof fitted mattress protectors are included, but a live purchasable zip-on encasement was not verified; zip-on standard remains unmet.
rental_checks.notes: Tuck chair fully after use;23in route is not a36in comfort aisle. Confirm desk knee-bay fit and slider curtain stack before ordering. Quality south nightstand has only2in to the estimated entry opening; the +/-3in survey can erase it. Closet rack requires19in clear internal depth, unmeasured. Nightstand/mattress alignment depends on unmeasured bed deck.
rental_checks.fabric_policy: No velvet, bouclé, white seating, glass-top or marble furniture. Functional safety-backed wall mirrors and electronic displays are not mirrored furniture. Removable bedding and shade fabric are not seat upholstery.

hard_rules: Task chair lacks a captured Wyzenbeek >=30000 and W/WS cleaning code for the exact selected upholstery; NOT rental-certified.

rental_checks.fabric_policy: No velvet, bouclé, white seating, glass-top or marble furniture. Functional safety-backed wall mirrors and electronic displays are not mirrored furniture. Removable bedding and shade fabric are not seat upholstery.

Very nice designDiannaLike the looks and design of this bed but the instructions are very poor. No language to help explain the pictures and some of the pictures are incorrect. Found it is best to look ahead of where you are in the process because some things are pictured better later in the process.

Soo much noise MilicaWe bought this bed 5 years ago. In the begit was really nice bed. But after 2-3 months it slowly started showing it's true colors. First headboard detached from bed construction. Then sides started to falling apart the same as headboard, and not much longer after footboard detached. We had to put so many L profiles hoping it would resolve our issues. They didn't. The worst thing is the amount of noise it makes. IT IS HORRIBLE I wake up every single time when my husband moves. Even when I put mu baby for a napon the bed, she also wakes up every time I try to "sneak out" because the sound is so bad. So yeah, I wouldn't recommend this to anybody even though it looks absolutely gorgeous.
